hero_desc: Discover, book and enjoy the best restaurants. Scan, order and pay without waiting.
feature1_desc: Search restaurants and dishes near you. Browse menus with photos, videos and real reviews from other diners.
feature2_desc: Choose your exact table on a visual floor plan. Specify adults, children and babies, and pre-order your drinks.
feature3_desc: Scan the QR code at your table, order more dishes, pay and tip without waiting for the waiter.
feature4_desc: Rate each dish and share your favorites on Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp or TikTok with a single tap.
feature5_desc: The KDS (Kitchen Display System) receives orders instantly with priority timers and voice announcements.
feature6_desc: Design your floor plan, manage the menu, inventory, staff and view performance reports.
role_diner_desc: Book, pre-order and pay via QR
role_chef_desc: View orders on the KDS screen
role_superadmin_desc: Manage all restaurants on the platform
cta_desc: Join hundreds of restaurants that have already digitized their operation with RMS.
